verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents an official CLI at docs.coderabbit.ai/cli/, and a probe confirmed that page exists. The CLI delivers AI code reviews on uncommitted changes before you commit or push. It is also designed for agentic workflows: Claude Code can trigger CodeRabbit reviews through the CLI integration and then fix the issues it finds. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documented detail on the CLI's command surface, installation and auth beyond review-before-commit.
